description: This Java class 'CoreEvents' handles web application events such as returning success/error responses, scheduling services with recurrence, running services, and streaming files. It is part of the OFBiz framework, specifically within the webapp event package, and manages event-driven service invocation and file streaming functionalities.

classes.name: CoreEvents
classes.description: Handles web application events such as service scheduling, execution, and file streaming within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: returnSuccess
methods.description: Returns a success string, used as a placeholder event response.

methods.name: returnError
methods.description: Returns an error string, used as a placeholder event response.

methods.name: returnNull
methods.description: Returns null, used as a placeholder event response.

methods.name: scheduleService
methods.description: Schedules a service with optional recurrence based on request parameters, handling validation, permissions, and error reporting.

methods.name: saveServiceResultsToSession
methods.description: Saves results from a synchronized service call into the session for later retrieval.

methods.name: getObjectFromServicePath
methods.description: Retrieves nested objects from service results based on a service path string, handling maps, entities, and collections.

methods.name: runService
methods.description: Executes a specified service, performing security checks and handling synchronous or asynchronous invocation.

methods.name: streamFile
methods.description: Streams a file to the browser based on the request path info.
